question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a grey ball, Bob has a brown ball, Claire has a blue ball, Dave has a black ball, Eve has a purple ball, Fred has a silver ball, and Gertrude has a teal ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Gertrude and Bob swap balls. Then, Dave and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Claire and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Dave and Gertrude swap balls. Then, Claire and Dave swap balls. Then, Alice and Eve swap balls. Finally, Gertrude and Bob swap balls. At the end of the game, Fred has the
Options:
(A) grey ball
(B) brown ball
(C) blue ball
(D) black ball
(E) purple ball
(F) silver ball
(G) teal ball
solution:
Ball colors in player order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: grey, brown, blue, black, purple, silver, teal.
1. Gertrude–Bob: grey, teal, blue, black, purple, silver, brown.
2. Dave–Gertrude: grey, teal, blue, brown, purple, silver, black.
3. Claire–Gertrude: grey, teal, black, brown, purple, silver, blue.
4. Dave–Gertrude: grey, teal, black, blue, purple, silver, brown.
5. Claire–Dave: grey, teal, blue, black, purple, silver, brown.
6. Alice–Eve: purple, teal, blue, black, grey, silver, brown.
7. Gertrude–Bob: purple, brown, blue, black, grey, silver, teal.
Fred has the silver ball, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
